title: ICD coding (disease classifications)
summary: The WHO ICD-11 code list shipped with the server, a hospital's licensed ICD-10, the ICD picker in every coding screen, codes checked against the active list and sent with their titles, coded morbidity and mortality statistics.
markdown:
# ICD coding (disease classifications)

The Punjab Healthcare Commission's MSDS wants diagnoses coded "as per the International Classification of Diseases,
10th or as revised from time to time" (indicator 148), and the quality committee to watch how completely records are
coded (105 vii). Haspataal codes clinical notes, discharge summaries and death certificates in **ICD-11** out of the box,
and in **ICD-10** once the hospital loads the WHO file it is licensed to use.

## The code lists

| Classification | Where it comes from | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| **ICD-11 MMS** (WHO release 2026-01, English; 18 505 codes of chapters 01-26 and V) | ships with the server; `hms migrate apply` loads it, and a server upgrade brings WHO's next yearly release | WHO, CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO: free, also in commercial software, **with the attribution** (`icd11_citation`) and codes never changed |
| **ICD-10** | the hospital loads it (`POST /icd/releases`) | WHO licenses ICD-10 separately (an internal-use licence for the hospital, licensing@who.int); it never ships with the product |

`GET /icd/releases` → every release loaded (`source` Bundled / Imported, `code_count`, `licence_note`, `is_active`),
`coding_system` (the classification doctors code in: setting `icd_coding_system`, ICD-11 by default) and
`icd11_citation`. One release per classification is **active**: the picker searches it and new codes must be in it.

## The picker (screen `icd_picker`, inside every coding screen)

1. `GET /icd/codes?q=…[&system=ICD-11|ICD-10][&limit=30]` as the doctor types (2+ characters, debounced): a code prefix
   (`CA40`) or words in any order (`pneumonia bacterial`). Exact code first, then code prefixes in the
   classification's order, then titles starting with the words; specific codes before residual ones
   (`is_residual`: "other specified", "unspecified"). Show `code` in bold, `title`, and `parent_title` in grey.
2. Browsing: `GET /icd/browse` → the chapters; `GET /icd/browse?parent=12` → a chapter's blocks; `?parent=CA40` → a
   category's children.
3. One code: `GET /icd/codes/{code}` → the entry, `ancestors` (chapter → blocks → categories) and `children`.
4. Show `icd11_citation` in small print at the picker's foot. `ICD_SYSTEM_NOT_LOADED`: no active list of that
   classification (ICD-10 before the hospital loads it).

Store the **code** only:

| Record | Field |
|---|---|
| clinical note | `icd_codes` (`POST /clinical-encounters`, `PATCH /clinical-encounters/{id}`) |
| discharge summary | `icd_codes` (`PUT /admissions/{id}/discharge-summary`); `suggested.icd_terms` offers the notes' codes |
| death certificate | `cause_a_icd` … `cause_d_icd`, `other_conditions_icd` (`POST /patients/{id}/death`, `PUT /deaths/{id}`) |

Codes are normalized (upper case, no spaces, each once) and each must be a category of the **active** list of its
classification (a code's format tells which: ICD-11 codes have a letter second, `CA40.Z`; ICD-10 a digit, `J18.9`).
Otherwise `ICD_CODE_UNKNOWN` with `details.unknown` (the codes) and `details.loaded` (the classifications loaded).
Wherever codes come back they come with **`icd_terms`**: `[{code, system, title, uri}]` (a death record also has
`underlying_term`). Show code and title, never a bare code: the ICD-11 licence asks for code, title and URI together.

## Loading ICD-10 or a newer ICD-11 (screen `icd_code_lists`, Quality Officer or Super Admin)

`POST /icd/releases` (multipart, permission `icd.release.manage`):

| Field | |
|---|---|
| `file` | ClaML XML (the format WHO distributes classifications in), WHO's ICD-11 simple tabulation (`.zip` or `.txt`), or a CSV / TSV with `code` and `title` columns (optionally `kind`, `parent`, `chapter`) |
| `code_system` | `ICD-10` or `ICD-11` |
| `release_label` | e.g. `2019` |
| `licence_note` | required for ICD-10: the WHO licence the hospital holds |
| `activate` | `true` (default): it becomes the active list of its classification |

The file is checked: every code in the classification's format and every entry titled (`ICD_IMPORT_INVALID`,
`details.examples`); a release already loaded → `ICD_RELEASE_EXISTS`. A release never changes: load a corrected one and
activate it (`POST /icd/releases/{release_id}/activate`). Codes already in records keep their titles (from the release
that has them).

Switching the classification doctors code in: the Super Admin sets `icd_coding_system` (`PUT /admin/settings/icd_coding_system
{"value": "ICD-10"}`), refused (`ICD_SYSTEM_NOT_LOADED`) until a list of that classification is active. Both
classifications stay valid in records; no mapping between them is offered (WHO licenses mappings separately).

## Coded diagnosis statistics (screens `disease_statistics`, `disease_statistics_owner`)

`GET /icd/statistics?date_from=…&date_to=…&limit=50` (permission `icd.statistics.view`: Quality Officer, Owner, Hospital
Admin), this month so far by default:

* `completeness`: per source (OPD: finalized OPD, follow-up and emergency notes; Inpatient: patients discharged; Deaths:
  deaths certified) the records and how many carry a code, `coded_pct` (MSDS 105 vii);
* `chapters`: counts per chapter (OPD, inpatient, deaths, total); `top_codes`: the most frequent codes with titles;
* `citation`: print it at the foot of the report when ICD-11 was used.

The mortality statistics (`GET /deaths/statistics`) group the underlying causes by ICD category (the ICD-10 three-character
category or the ICD-11 stem code) with its title. The record review's `ICD_CODED` check passes when a finalized note or
the signed discharge summary carries a code.
